reference/homepage.png.analysis:
regions:
- Page > Header: white top bar containing the railway brand block at the left and utility navigation at the right.
- Page > Primary navigation bar: full-width blue bar directly beneath the header, containing Home, Booking and Travel guides entries.
- Page > Hero banner: full-width nighttime railway photograph with three carousel indicators near the lower left and a wide search panel overlapping the banner's lower edge.
- Hero banner > Search panel: white floating card containing an information notice, a horizontal From/To/Date/Search form row, and an unchecked High-speed trains only checkbox.
- Page > Quick Guide section: white content area below the hero with a blue heading and two columns of FAQ links, plus a More link below the right column.
- Page > Footer: pale gray full-width band with three centered lines of copyright, registration and policy text.
- No sidebar, modal dialog, loading state, empty state or error message is visible.

visible_controls:
- Header: China Railway 12306 brand mark at left, with a red circular railway emblem and product name block; Login and Register text links in the utility navigation.
- Header utility navigation: My 12306 dropdown control with down chevron; 简体中文 language dropdown control with down chevron; Contact us link with telephone icon.
- Primary navigation: Home link; Booking link with down chevron; Travel guides link with down chevron.
- Hero banner: three carousel dot indicators; the first is filled/active and the next two are dimmed.
- Search panel: From field with location-pin icon and visible value Beijing(北京).
- Search panel: To field with location-pin icon and visible value Shanghai(上海).
- Search panel: circular orange swap button with opposing arrows between the From and To fields.
- Search panel: Date field with calendar icon and visible value Fri, May 29.
- Search panel: large orange Search button.
- Search panel: unchecked checkbox labeled High-speed trains only.
- Quick Guide: four FAQ text links, each preceded by a small blue square bullet.
- Quick Guide: More> text link below the right-hand FAQ column.
- Footer: Privacy Policy and Cookie Statement links separated by a vertical bar.

layout_cues:
- Header content sits in a wide horizontal container, with the brand block left-aligned and the utility navigation right-aligned; a thin separator divides the header from the navigation bar.
- The primary navigation bar spans the full viewport width and is shallow; its items are left-aligned and separated by subtle vertical rules.
- The hero banner is full-bleed and tall, occupying a major portion of the first screen, with the white search panel centered horizontally and overlapping its lower boundary.
- The search panel is nearly as wide as the main content container, with generous internal padding; the notice spans the full card width above a single horizontal row of fields and button.
- In the search form, From, To and Date occupy roughly equal columns, the orange Search button occupies the right end, and the checkbox sits alone below the fields at the left.
- The Quick Guide section uses a wide centered content container; the heading is left-aligned, with two FAQ columns spaced widely apart and the More link under the right column.
- There is substantial white space below the Quick Guide links before the footer begins.
- The footer is full-width and centered; its three lines stack vertically with modest line spacing.

style_cues:
- Overall appearance is a corporate travel-booking interface: white header and content areas, a saturated blue navigation band and a dark photographic hero.
- The header brand is prominent: a red circular railway emblem beside large dark Chinese characters and a smaller gray uppercase subtitle; utility links are smaller and muted dark gray.
- The primary navigation uses white text on a medium-blue fill, with thin lighter vertical separators and no prominent individual button fills.
- The hero image is a night scene dominated by dark sky, warm orange bokeh and light trails, and a silver-white high-speed train on an elevated structure; the image has high contrast against the white search card.
- The search card is white with softly rounded corners and a light drop shadow; its notice text is small and gray with a gray circular information icon.
- Search fields use thin light gray borders, white backgrounds, small gray labels with line icons, and larger dark values; the Search button is bright orange with white text.
- Quick Guide uses a medium-large blue heading, small blue square list bullets, and dark gray link text; More> is lighter gray and lower emphasis.
- The footer has a pale gray background with small centered gray text and links, creating low visual emphasis compared with the hero and search panel.

reference/register.png.analysis:
regions:
- Page > Header: white top bar with the China Railway 12306 logo at the left and a pale, rounded utility area at the right containing account, language and contact entries.
- Page > Primary navigation: full-width blue bar directly beneath the header with Home, Booking and Travel guides entries.
- Page > Breadcrumb strip: white area between navigation and the main card, showing the current-location path.
- Page > Main registration card: large white panel with a thin light border, centered in the page and containing the registration form.
- Main registration card > Form fields: repeated rows with a right-aligned required-label column, a fixed-width input/control column, and optional helper text or links at the right.
- Main registration card > Gender group: two side-by-side bordered radio-option boxes beneath the Gender label.
- Main registration card > Consent and submit area: an unchecked agreement checkbox with policy links, followed by a centered orange submit button.
- Page > Footer: full-width pale gray band containing copyright text, Chinese registration numbers and two policy links, all centered.

visible_controls:
- Header > Logo: red circular railway emblem plus 中国铁路12306 and 12306 CHINA RAILWAY text.
- Header utility bar: Login link; Register link; My 12306 dropdown with down caret; 简体中文 dropdown with down caret; headset icon with Contact us link.
- Header far right: faint small icon/control partially visible at the edge; its exact shape is unclear.
- Primary navigation: Home link; Booking dropdown link with down caret; Travel guides dropdown link with down caret.
- Breadcrumb: HOME link and blue Create an account link.
- Nationality: select control showing placeholder Please select, with a down caret.
- Name: blank text input, with adjacent blue link Check the rules for filling out passport information.
- Passport number: blank text input.
- Passport expiration date: blank date input with a calendar icon at its right edge.
- Date of birth: blank date input with a calendar icon at its right edge.
- Gender: two bordered radio-option controls labeled Male and Female; both radio circles appear unselected.
- Username: blank text input.
- Password: blank text input.
- Confirm Password: blank text input.
- Email address: blank text input, with orange helper text at the right.
- Consent: unchecked square checkbox followed by agreement text containing Terms of Service and Privacy Policy links.
- Next step: large orange button, enabled.
- Footer: Privacy Policy link and Cookie Statement link.

layout_cues:
- Header spans the full width and is roughly 70 px tall. The logo is left-aligned with generous page margin; account and language utilities sit right, grouped inside a large pale rounded container.
- The blue primary navigation is a full-width horizontal band roughly 42 px tall. Its three entries are left-aligned with moderate spacing rather than spread across the full width.
- The breadcrumb sits below the navigation, left-aligned with the content area, at a much smaller text size than the header and navigation.
- The main card is centered horizontally with roughly 120 px side margins and a height covering most of the viewport below the breadcrumb. It has spacious white padding above and around the form.
- The registration form is vertically stacked. Labels are right-aligned in a fixed column; inputs and selects share a consistent width of roughly 365 px and start at a common left edge.
- Form rows are separated by substantial vertical whitespace, producing a low-density layout. Helper notices are aligned to the right of their corresponding controls on the same row.
- The Gender controls form two equal-width bordered boxes in one horizontal row. Each contains a radio circle at the left and text beside it.
- The agreement row sits below the form fields, inset from the input column, with the checkbox on the left and wrapped policy text beside it. The Next step button is centered beneath this block.
- The footer occupies a separate full-width band below the card, with all content centered in three stacked lines and wide horizontal breathing room.
- No sidebar, dialog, overlay, pagination or additional columns are visible. Content is fully contained within the screenshot.

style_cues:
- Overall page background is white; the header is white, the primary navigation is a saturated medium blue, and the footer is very light gray.
- The logo emblem is bright red with a dark/black interior mark. The Chinese brand text is large, bold and near-black; the Latin tagline below is smaller, lighter gray and spaced out.
- Header utility text is dark gray/black in a small sans-serif font. The utility group sits on a subtly shaded pale-gray rounded surface. The Register link has no visible selected treatment.
- Primary navigation text is white and regular-weight; no active underline or highlighted navigation item is apparent.
- Breadcrumb text is small and muted gray, with the final breadcrumb link in blue.
- Form labels are dark gray/black, regular weight, with a red asterisk preceding each required field. Colons follow every label.
- Text inputs and selects have white fills, thin light-gray borders, small corner radii and plain placeholder text in gray. Date fields include small outline calendar icons aligned at the right.
- Helper text is orange and small; the passport-information helper is a blue underlined link. Agreement links are blue and underlined.
- Gender option boxes have thin light-gray borders and a slightly off-white background. Radio circles are neutral gray outlines with no visible selected dot.
- The Next step button is solid orange, wide and low-profile, with white centered text, modest rounded corners and no prominent shadow.
- Footer text is medium gray, centered and small, with vertical-bar separators between the registration-number entries and between the policy links.
- Typography is sans-serif throughout, with stronger/larger branding text and smaller, lighter body and utility text. No photographic imagery, gradients or decorative illustrations are visible beyond the logo and small line icons.
